result.reason: The edit appropriately caps the Company’s termination payment at an amount based on three months’ fees and excludes breach-based termination, fitting part of the fallback. However, Section 4.1 still permits either party—including HDI—to terminate on 90 days’ notice without limiting HDI’s right to the end of a committed term, so the fallback is not fully achieved. Drafting is also imperfect because the lesser-of formula could produce a negative Termination Payment if Net Sales are below $800,000, and the margin comment misidentifies the payment provision as Section 4.2.
